title: Pure Mekk-Knight
summary: The pure Mekk-Knight Psychic column-control build with World Legacy Spells and Traps, Lib the World Key Blademaster, and generic staples. Every Main Deck Mekk-Knight Special Summons itself into a column that already holds 2 or more cards, turning the opponent's board setup into free extensions and column-wide negations.

summary.title: Starters
points: Girsu, the Orcust Mekk-Knight sends a World Legacy card from the Deck to the GY on summon and summons a World Legacy Token to both fields when you control no other monsters—creating a 2-card column on Turn 1.
Mekk-Knight Purple Nightfall banishes a Mekk-Knight you control (including itself) until your next Standby Phase as a Quick Effect to search any Mekk-Knight monster.
Mekk-Knight Blue Sky searches differently named Mekk-Knight monsters equal to the number of opponent's cards in its column when summoned from the hand.

summary.title: Opening: Girsu into Morning Star, Lib & Column Locks
steps: Normal Summon Girsu, the Orcust Mekk-Knight to dump a World Legacy card to the GY, then activate its second effect to summon a World Legacy Token to your field and the opponent's field in the same column.
Special Summon Mekk-Knight Purple Nightfall or Mekk-Knight Blue Sky into that column to search Mekk-Knight Indigo Eclipse.

Link Summon Mekk-Knight of the Morning Star using Girsu and your Token to discard a card and search World Legacy's Secret (or Link Summon Lib the World Key Blademaster while a World Legacy card is in your GY to Set a World Legacy Spell/Trap directly from the Deck).
Special Summon Indigo Eclipse and Set your World Legacy Trap so Indigo Eclipse can shift your Mekk-Knights into whatever column the opponent activates effects in.

summary.title: Column Movement & Disruption
summary.text: While World Legacy's Secret, World Legacy Whispers, and World Legacy Key are face-up on the field, they negate any opponent's monster effect, Spell effect, or Trap effect that resolves in the same column as a Mekk-Knight monster you control. Mekk-Knight Indigo Eclipse moves a Mekk-Knight to another Main Monster Zone as a Quick Effect on either turn, letting one Mekk-Knight police two different columns.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Mekk-Knight Spectrum Supreme can attack directly if it is the only card in its column, cannot be targeted or destroyed while it points to no monsters, and sends a card in its column to the GY to Special Summon a Mekk-Knight from the Deck.
Mekk-Knight Crusadia Avramax cannot be targeted by opponent's card effects, draws all attacks onto itself, and gains the ATK of any Special Summoned monster it battles.
Lib the World Key Blademaster Sets a World Legacy Spell/Trap from the Deck and shuffles 1 card on the field into the Deck without targeting when used as Link Material.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: World Legacy's Memory Special Summons a Mekk-Knight from your hand or Deck at Quick-Play speed (locking you into Mekk-Knight summons for the rest of the turn) and returns it to the hand during the End Phase.

World Legacy's Secret revives a Level 5 or higher monster from your GY and negates opposing monster effects in a Mekk-Knight's column; World Legacy Whispers and World Legacy Key do the same for Spells and Traps.
World Legacy Scars boosts Mekk-Knights by 300 ATK/DEF, loots by discarding a Mekk-Knight, and can banish 8 differently named Mekk-Knights to send the opponent's entire hand and Extra Deck to the GY.
